original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 When consumer money moves natively into stablecoin wallets, the entire liquidity setup for $BTC changes. CoinDesk reports that stablecoin wallets are now directly challenging traditional bank accounts as consumer money hubs. This matters because capital sitting on-chain eliminates multi-day fiat conversion delays. When liquidity stays natively digital, the friction of reallocating into spot Bitcoin disappears. With $BTC compressing near $79,400, this structural expansion in on-chain settlement creates a persistent liquidity cushion right beneath current price consolidation. Bullish, bearish, or wait Is the market confirming this catalyst, or fading it?
